issue.body:
## Problem

`sample-kit recent` prints entries in insertion order, so the newest work is at the bottom of a long list.

## Fix

Sort the entries by `updatedAt`, newest first, before printing.

## Done when

- [ ] `recent` prints entries newest first by `updatedAt`.
- [ ] A test with three entries checks the order.

pr.title: feat(sample-kit): sort recent entries
pr.body: Sorts the entries `recent` prints, with a test.
